"""Run exact candidate with read-only main dependencies and offline/write guards."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import uuid

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent.resolve()
MAIN = Path('/Users/turshevr/toto-ai')
MODE = sys.argv[1]
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
blocked = []

def audit(event, args):
    if event.startswith(('socket.connect', 'socket.getaddrinfo', 'subprocess.Popen', 'os.system')) or event == 'sqlite3.connect':
        blocked.append({'event': event, 'test': os.environ.get('PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST')})
        raise RuntimeError('review forbids network/process/DB access: ' + event)
    paths = []
    if event == 'open' and isinstance(args[0], (str, bytes, os.PathLike)):
        path, mode, flags = args
        if isinstance(mode, str) and any(c in mode for c in 'wax+') or isinstance(flags, int) and flags & (os.O_WRONLY | os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC | os.O_APPEND):
            paths = [path]
        elif Path(path).name == '.env' and not Path(path).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT):
            raise RuntimeError('review forbids real secret files')
    elif event in ('os.mkdir', 'os.remove', 'os.rmdir', 'os.chmod', 'os.utime'):
        paths = [args[0]]
    elif event in ('os.rename', 'os.link', 'os.symlink'):
        paths = [args[0], args[1]]
    for path in paths:
        if isinstance(path, (str, bytes, os.PathLike)) and not Path(os.fsdecode(path)).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT):
            blocked.append({'event': event, 'test': os.environ.get('PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST')})
            raise RuntimeError('review forbids write outside temporary root')

sys.addaudithook(audit)
os.environ['PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD'] = '1'
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT), str(MAIN / 'src')]
import toto_ai.external_odds

name = 'toto_ai.external_odds.goal_api'
candidate = ROOT / 'src/toto_ai/external_odds/goal_api.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, candidate)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[name] = module
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
setattr(toto_ai.external_odds, 'goal_api', module)
assert hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '73d6d9e6185c35fab07565ce0566c15f869ad19f907547ab70f89bed5b28ccbb'

import pytest
tests = ['tests/test_goal_api_pagination_identity.py', 'tests/test_goal_api_provider.py', 'tests/test_goal_api_schedule_collection.py', 'tests/test_schedule_source_collector.py'] if MODE == 'focused' else ['tests/test_independent_review.py']
code = pytest.main(['-q', '-x', '--tb=short', '--log-file', str(ROOT / (MODE + '-pytest.log')), '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-c', str(ROOT / 'pytest.ini'), '--rootdir', str(ROOT), '--basetemp', str(ROOT / ('pytest-' + MODE + '-' + uuid.uuid4().hex)), *[str(ROOT / t) for t in tests]])
loaded = {}
for key, value in list(sys.modules.items()):
    if key.startswith(('toto_ai', 'tests')) and getattr(value, '__file__', None):
        path = Path(value.__file__).resolve()
        if path.suffix == '.py' and path.exists():
            loaded[str(path)] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(ROOT / (MODE + '-runtime.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'exit_code': code, 'blocked_actions': blocked, 'loaded_source_sha256': loaded}, indent=2))
raise SystemExit(code)
